neighbours.label: lowercase 'i' suffixed to a capitalised product acronym (DSi, STi, ECi)
fire: My little brother still plays games on his old Nintendo DSi every day.
He sold his hatchback and bought a Subaru STi last month.
The kit fits both the DS and the DSi without any glue.
The forum is full of STi owners comparing turbo upgrades.
The engine uses ECi cylinder assemblies from the supplier.
She found a cheap DSi at a flea market on Saturday.
Insurance for an STi costs more than for the base model.
The charger works with the DSi and the newer handhelds.

notes: Card: 'i' x14 in STi, ECi, DS/DSi, SOiL; ':' x16 after initials (RE:, DW:). Testing the 'i' side only.
